svg.title: DoAgvAssignments consumes a shallow copy of the DAG
svg.desc: Rounds of DoAgvAssignments: the copy loses its roots one by one while ctx->events gains AGV events; both point at the same event objects.

g.text: The copy is a work queue (Kahn's algorithm in rounds): its roots are the events whose prerequisites are all assigned. Phase 1 drains non-tray roots, phase 2 matches AGVs to the TrayMove roots with
